create_location_based_filter: create a LocationBasedFilter component that enforces partial observability rules based on agent locations in a simulation
extract_locations_from_narrative: extract entity locations from a narrative string by parsing SCENE headers and Present lists
filter_narrative_for_entity: filter a narrative to return only scenes where a specific entity was present using regex or LLM fallback
check_can_observe: check whether one entity can observe another by comparing their current locations
update_entity_locations: update the internal location tracking for all entities by providing a new entity-to-location mapping
